reviewer: Codex AI source-grounded review, 2026-11-04; not human review.
method: Read all 78 completed-run omission explanations against the pinned original sentence and surrounding paragraph. Accept requires the right verdict and a specific correct explanation of whether the omission changes meaning. The answer key was visible; this is not blind or independent human validation. Minor wording slips are recorded separately. No new paid model runs were made for reanalysis.
prior_review: The uploaded bundle also contained Claude Opus 5.5 AI review decisions. Those original files are preserved in the uploaded bundle; the decisions here are a separate source-grounded review.
